reports.text: CEB notice: planned power interruption in Rajagiriya tomorrow 09:00-15:00 for line maintenance.
Call centre: 40 customers around Divulapitiya say data is very slow and calls keep dropping.
Social media post: "heard the Beruwala tower is already fixed, the company van came" (unconfirmed).
NMS 06:00 | CRITICAL | BER18 | RRU hardware fault, cells out of service

policy.evidence_rule: Authoritative evidence must be consistent; equally authoritative conflicts require confirmation. Recency alone does not verify a fact.
policy.on_crew_loss: Pause affected unfinished work and request operator review; preserve completed repairs.

finding.finding: Beruwala (S01) has a verified equipment outage from the authoritative NMS snapshot; the rumor does not override it. The catalog provides equipment repair options for S01 and the available crews have equipment skills, so no evidence-based safety or impossibility reason supports deferring work. The Divulapitiya complaint is not an asset-state claim, and the planned Rajagiriya interruption is future and does not map to a listed site. Per approved policy, V03 at Payagala (S03) is critical with weight 5; all other listed services have weight 1. No credible evidence warrants changing any priority.

findings: The authoritative NMS report V2-01-OBS-01 identifies BER18, which resolves to S01 (Beruwala), and states an RRU hardware fault with cells out of service. The equipment_ok=false fact is correctly targeted and supported.
V3-EVAL2-001-X03 is an explicitly unconfirmed social-media rumor about Beruwala being fixed. Recording its claim as unverified does not contradict or displace the authoritative fault report.

EQ-S01 addresses the identified equipment fault. The provided plan shows travel from DEPOT to S01 before work begins; arithmetic is consistent: work starts at 5, lasts 60 minutes, and ends at 65. No cited evidence makes this action unsafe or impossible.
